items.question: What three actions form the rule in the verse?
What everyday situation does the verse mention first?
In what other situation does the verse suggest using the rule?
items.modelAnswer: It suggests using the rule when looking for clues.

items.question: What main idea can you infer from the verse?
items.modelAnswer: It encourages pausing and paying attention before acting or drawing conclusions.

items.question: Why are looking and listening useful when searching for clues?
items.modelAnswer: They help a person notice visual details and sounds rather than rushing past relevant information.

activities.instruction: Write a short paragraph about paying attention while learning. Use the idea of the verse without filling the listening passage’s missing words.
activities.modelAnswer: Before I begin a task, I pause and read the instructions carefully. I look for details that show what I need to do. I listen to the teacher and ask when something is unclear. If I am solving a problem, I collect clues instead of guessing immediately. I check my work before handing it in. These habits help me work thoughtfully and notice mistakes.
